no_provider_calls.statement: This audit performed no provider calls and did not modify any paid input. All evidence was produced by reading files and by offline, read-only API calls.
evidence: No enrichment, publication, or refresh command was executed during the audit; only file reads, shell hashing, and JSON queries.
docs/audits/hob-587-run-manifest.sha256 was captured before any audit computation and is re-checked by the probe after its run (run_tree_unchanged and run_tree_matches_manifest).
The probe imports no provider client and reports provider_client_imported=false.

The executed probe revisions deny network inside their own process: socket.getaddrinfo, socket.create_connection, socket.connect and socket.connect_ex raise before any stage runs, and the report counts the denied attempts (network_denial). A stage that needed the network would be reported blocked rather than silently succeeding; both runs reported zero blocked attempts.
no_provider_calls.caveat: Absence of provider calls is asserted for audit activity on this machine; it does not describe the original paid run, which recorded 545 attempts and 544 provider responses.
